title: ר' אבינא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rabbi Avina said in Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba’s name in Rav’s name (end of chapter Rabbi Eliezer Demilah). He asked Rav Sheshet; and Rav Chisda, Ketubbot 24b. He said in Geniva’s name (Ellu Tereifot 50b); Rabbi Abba bar Mammal; Rav Iva. Rabbi Ze'ira asked him, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Hakkotev. Rabbi Chila in his name; Rabbi Tavlai in Rav’s name. Rabbi Yose said in Rabbi Avina’s name. Before Rabbi Yirmeyah, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot; Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Bon. Rabbi Avina said, “The Holy One’s anger is a moment,” Berakhot 7a. At 4b, “Rabbi Elazar said in Rabbi Avina’s name” is an error; it should read “Rabbi Elazar bar Avina said”; see there.
